metadata.title: preflight: fail-fast Jira credential validation gate
metadata.description: Add a registerPreflight credential-validation gate that aborts network-mutating pm-jira commands (jira sync, jira import, jira export --push) BEFORE any pm-store read or Jira REST call when JIRA_BASE_URL/JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN are missing. Makes the long-standing 'preflight' capability claim (CHANGELOG / pm-jira-4804 / pm-jira-vfb3) actually true.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.resolution: registerPreflight override added (scoped to network-mutating jira sync/import + export --push, skips --dry-run/validate); validates JIRA_BASE_URL/JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN via existing diagnoseCreds; aborts via stderr+process.exit(2) because the runtime swallows thrown errors. 'preflight' added to manifest capabilities. Also fixed runImport dry-run-requires-creds ordering bug.
metadata.expected_result: Mutating jira commands with missing creds abort immediately (exit 2, clear message) before any pm-store/Jira call; validate + --dry-run + export-without-push remain creds-free; good creds pass through silently.
metadata.actual_result: All confirmed in scratch workspace: sync/import/export --push abort exit 2 with preflight message; validate/dry-run(x2)/export-no-push exit 0; good (dummy) creds pass preflight and fail only at network. typecheck+build clean; 50/50 tests pass.
metadata.close_reason: Implemented and functionally verified the fail-fast preflight credential gate; makes the prior 'preflight' capability claim true.

metadata.title: Add publish retry + provenance fallback to release workflow
metadata.description: Replace the npm publish step in .github/workflows/release.yml with a resilient version that (1) skips if the version is already published, (2) retries up to 3 times with 30s sleep, and (3) falls back to publishing without --provenance after persistent registry 404s. Permanent fix for the 2026-05-27 npm E404 outage that left all 19 packages tagged in git but unpublished on npm.

metadata.title: Export --push aborts the whole batch on the first failed item
metadata.description: The exporter create/update loops in registerExporter threw a CommandError inside the loop on the first failed item, so one bad item (invalid issuetype, a required custom field, a 4xx) aborted the entire batch, abandoning all remaining items with no record of what succeeded and risking duplicates on retry. The import path and the sibling pm-linear exporter already isolate per-item failures.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.acceptance_criteria: per-item create/update failures are isolated and counted; the batch completes and reports a summary; successful items keep provenance; happy path + dry-run byte-identical; unit test proves continue-on-failure
